11-Day Grand Morocco Tour: Cities, Desert & Coast
summary:
The 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour follows an extensive escorted route through Morocco, combining imperial cities with the Atlantic coast, mountain regions and the desert south. Travel from Marrakech to Essaouira and Casablanca, then continue through Rabat, Fez and the Roman site of Volubilis before heading toward Ouarzazate, Zagora, Erfoud and Todra Gorge. The longer format allows several contrasting regions to be covered within one organized circuit.
Unlike our private itineraries, this is a small-group coach tour with scheduled departures every Friday throughout the year. The package includes selected hotels with breakfast, guided sightseeing, deluxe coach transportation, airport transfers, entrance fees and porterage services.

itinerary.title: Friday: Arrival in Marrakech
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Marrakech Menara Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Marrakech.
Hotel check-in and free time for the rest of the day. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Saturday: Essaouira –> El Jadida -> Casablanca (490 km)
itinerary.text: Early morning drive to Essaouira, the historic Atlantic coastal city. Explore the old fortified port and Portuguese heritage sites. Optional seafood lunch in Essaouira. Continue to Casablanca along the Atlantic coast with stops in Oualidia and El Jadida, including an orientation tour of the former Portuguese fortress of Mazagan. Overnight in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Casablanca -> Meknes -> Fez (320 km)
itinerary.text: Short city tour of Casablanca, Morocco’s economic capital. Visit the Central Market, Habous District, Royal Palace, Mohammed V Square, and the Anfa residential area. See the exterior of the Hassan II Mosque. Drive to Meknes with optional lunch. Visit Bab Mansour, the Royal Stables, and the Jewish Quarter before continuing to Fez. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Monday: Visiting Fez
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Fez, Morocco’s spiritual capital. Explore the Medieval Medina and traditional souks. Visit the Bou Inania Madrasa or Attarine Medersa, Nejjarine Fountain, and the Moulay Idriss II Mausoleum. See the exterior of the historic University of al-Qarawiyyin Mosque. Lunch at the hotel. Continue exploring the local souks and handicraft markets. Optional traditional dinner with folklore show in the Medina. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Fez -> Rabat -> Marrakech (495 km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Moulay Idriss Zerhoun, one of Morocco’s holy cities. Visit the Roman ruins of Volubilis before continuing to Rabat, the administrative capital of Morocco. Visit the Royal Palace of Rabat (Mechouar), Kasbah of the Udayas, and its gardens. Optional seafood lunch in Rabat. Continue to Marrakesh via highway. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Visiting Marrakech
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Marrakech known as the “Pearl of the South.” Visit the Menara Gardens, Saadian Tombs, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and Dar Si Said Museum. Explore the traditional souks and handicraft quarters before visiting the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa square with its lively entertainment. Optional dinner in Marrakesh. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Marrakech –> Ouarzazate -> Zagora (380 km)
itinerary.text: Drive through the Tizi n'Tichka mountain pass at 2,260 meters altitude. Visit Aït Benhaddou, the famous UNESCO-listed Kasbah featured in many films. Optional lunch at a local restaurant. Continue through the scenic Draa Valley to Zagora. Overnight in Zagora.

itinerary.title: Friday: Zagora –> Nkob ->Tazzarine –> Erfoud (300 km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Tamegroute and visit the famous pottery center. Continue through Tansikht and Nkob with scenic pre-Saharan and Berber village landscapes. Pass through Tazzarine and Alnif with optional lunch in Alnif. Continue to Erfoud via Rissani, birthplace of the Alaouite Dynasty. Optional 4x4 excursion to the Erg Chebbi dunes for sunset or sunrise. Overnight in Erfoud.

itinerary.title: Saturday: Erfoud -> Tinghir -> Ouarzazate (350 km)
itinerary.text: Optional early morning 4x4 excursion to Erg Chebbi to watch the sunrise over the dunes. Drive to Tinghir and visit the spectacular Todra Gorge. Optional lunch at a local restaurant near the canyons. Continue along the Road of 1,000 Kasbahs through Kelaat Mgouna and Skoura Oasis before arriving in Ouarzazate. Overnight in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Ouarzazate -> Marrakech (220 km)
itinerary.text: Breakfast. Enjoy an orientation city tour of Ouarzazate before continuing to Marrakech. Optional lunch at a local restaurant. Free afternoon at leisure in Marrakesh. Overnight in Marrakech.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour?
faqs.a: The 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour covers Marrakech, Casablanca, Essaouira, Fez, Rabat, and Ouarzazate. This comprehensive journey showcases Morocco's imperial cities, Atlantic coastline, historic medinas, desert landscapes, and cultural treasures, providing an in-depth exploration of the country. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire itinerary. Comfortable vehicles are used for all transfers and sightseeing, allowing travelers to enjoy Morocco's diverse landscapes and attractions with ease.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide fascinating insights into Morocco's history, architecture, culture, and local traditions throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a comprehensive introduction to Morocco. It combines the country's most famous cities, historic sites, coastal destinations, and cultural highlights into one well-balanced itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, historic sites, local markets, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the tour.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Marrakech, Casablanca, Essaouira, Fez, Rabat, and Ouarzazate?
faqs.a: Marrakech is famous for its colorful souks, palaces, gardens, and lively Jemaa el-Fnaa Square. Casablanca features the impressive Hassan II Mosque and modern city atmosphere. Essaouira offers charming coastal scenery and a historic medina. Fez is renowned for its medieval UNESCO-listed medina and traditional craftsmanship. Rabat showcases elegant historical monuments as Morocco's capital city. Ouarzazate is famous for its kasbahs, desert landscapes, and film studios.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 11-Day Grand Morocco Coach Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include a Sahara Desert extension, visit Chefchaouen, or modify the itinerary to suit your interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
